user.title: Step 1 of 2 · AeroDataBox API
user.description: Enter your AeroDataBox Basic RapidAPI key first. Choose the free plan and check the terms. You can leave this blank and use Avinor closer to departure. Adding the integration will automatically open the first-trip form.

data_description.aerodatabox_api_key: Optional. Saved locally in Home Assistant. No paid test lookup is performed during setup.

confirm_address.title: Confirm address
confirm_address.description: Choose the address. Airport margin: {airport_margin}. Extra time: {drive_buffer}.

init.title: Flight Assistant preferences
init.description: Configure departure address and margins. Optional: enter a RapidAPI AeroDataBox Basic key ($0/month with limits); confirm the free tier in RapidAPI. Blank key retains an existing key.

data_description.aerodatabox_api_key: Long-range lookup. RapidAPI Basic: 400 units/month hard cap; registration may require payment card. No key: Avinor close to departure.
data_description.clear_aerodatabox_key: Check to disable AeroDataBox and clear the saved key.

confirm_address.title: Confirm address
confirm_address.description: Choose the address. Airport margin: {airport_margin}. Extra time: {drive_buffer}.

add_flight.name: Add a flight
add_flight.description: Add a SAS or Norwegian flight and start monitoring.

user.title: Step 2 of 2 · Register your trip
user.description: Airline is inferred from flight number (SK=SAS, DY/D8=Norwegian, WF=Widerøe). Check stopover to add connecting flight numbers. Departure airport is optional but improves lookup matching. Set your airport arrival margin at the bottom.

data.transport_mode: How will you travel to the airport?
data.airport_margin_minutes: How early do you want to arrive at the airport?

data_description.flight_number: Airline is detected automatically from the flight number.
data_description.has_stopover: You can add the next flight number/date in the following screen.
data_description.airport_margin_minutes: 90 min = 1 h 30 min (domestic), 120 min = 2 h (international). Choose your own value.
data_description.origin_address: You can select a matching address from Entur.
data_description.transport_mode: Bus/train from Entur, taxi/car from Waze. Walking/cycling routes are not yet available.

confirm_origin.title: Confirm starting address
confirm_origin.description: Choose the correct address. Airport arrival margin: {airport_margin}.

flight.title: Next connecting flight
flight.description: Enter the next flight number and date. You can continue adding connections.

error.invalid_address: Address must be shorter than 200 characters.
error.invalid_flight: Check flight number, date and optional IATA code.
error.duplicate_flight: This flight leg is already added.
